metadata.trail: Stubaier Höhenweg (Stubai High Trail) — Selected Winner Route (Alt 1: Calibrated Alta Via 1 Match)

selected_route_waypoints.name: Oberissalm (Stöcklenalm)
selected_route_waypoints.desc: End of Oberbergtal road; luggage cableway to Franz-Senn-Hütte

selected_route_waypoints.name: Alpeineralm
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Gentle valley trail alongside Alpeiner Bach

selected_route_waypoints.name: Franz-Senn-Hütte
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Drop heavy packs; check into 4.5★ DAV rooms (hot showers, Wi-Fi)

selected_route_waypoints.name: Kuhgschwetz / Alpeiner Glacier View
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Scenic afternoon glacier stream walk (+200m out-and-back to 8.5 km)

selected_route_waypoints.name: Schrimmennieder Pass
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Main ridge pass (2,714m) between Oberbergtal & Falbeson

selected_route_waypoints.name: Neue Regensburger Hütte
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Rebuilt modern 5.0★ timber wing right beside waterfall

selected_route_waypoints.name: Grawagrubennieder Pass
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Highest main-trail pass on the Stubai High Trail (2,880m)

selected_route_waypoints.name: Mutterberger See
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Crystal-clear glacial lake above Dresdner Hütte

selected_route_waypoints.name: Dresdner Hütte
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Hotel-grade 5.0★ comfort, sauna, next to Fernau mid-station

selected_route_waypoints.name: Peiljoch Pass
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Steel-cable secured pass (2,676m) between Dresdner & Sulzenau

selected_route_waypoints.name: Grawa Alm & Grawa Waterfall
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps (viewing decks + optional early Bus 590)

selected_route_waypoints.name: Ruetz Katarakt / Tschangelair Alm
selected_route_waypoints.desc: Scenic WildeWasserWeg along the roaring Ruetz river

selected_route_waypoints.name: Falbeson / Ranalt (Bus 590)
selected_route_waypoints.desc: End of trek; direct Bus 590 back to Innsbruck Hbf

optional_variants.name: Optional Day 3 Afternoon: Fernau Klettersteig (C/D) / Egesengrat (2,631m)

waypoint.name: Fernau Klettersteig / Egesengrat Summit
waypoint.desc: Optional Day 3 afternoon Via Ferrata (C/D) or panoramic ridge walk (+320m, 2.5 hrs RT from Dresdner Hütte)

optional_variants.name: Optional Day 4 Peak Variant: Großer Trögler Summit (2,902m)

waypoint.name: Großer Trögler Summit (2,902m)
waypoint.desc: Optional Day 4 summit cross ridge (+226m above Peiljoch pass, descending to Blaue Lacke)

days.title: Day 1: Oberissalm → Franz-Senn-Hütte + Alpeiner Glacier Walk
Day 2: Franz-Senn-Hütte → Schrimmennieder (2,714m) → Neue Regensburger Hütte
Day 3: Neue Regensburger Hütte → Grawagrubennieder (2,880m) → Dresdner Hütte
Day 4: Dresdner Hütte → Peiljoch (2,676m) → Blaue Lacke → Sulzenauhütte
Day 5: Sulzenauhütte → Grawa Waterfall → WildeWasserWeg → Falbeson
